Outdoor Halloween Decorations: No wires and tools needed, halloween solar lights outdoor are easy to install. Just connect the poles and spikes into the ground where there is direct sunshine. The lighting quality and reliability receive mixed feedback - while some find them bright and working well throughout October, others report they dim quickly and stop working after a week. Moreover, the value for money is debated, with some considering them a great buy for the price while others say they're not worth the cost. Additionally, the product's lifespan is negative, with customers reporting they only last two days.

authors_reviews.title: Spooky purple solar lights - perfect for Halloween
authors_reviews.text: Halloween is my absolute favorite holiday to decorate for, and these purple solar torch lights are the perfect addition to my outdoor decorations! I love flickering flame lights because they create such a fun, spooky atmosphere, and the purple glow on these gives my yard an extra eerie Halloween vibe. They’re a great way to add some color and ambiance along walkways, in the garden, or around the porch without having to worry about real flames. I also love that they’re solar-powered, so there are no cords to deal with or outlets needed. Simply assemble them, place them somewhere they can get plenty of sunlight, and let them automatically light up when it gets dark.Another thing I appreciate is how easy these lights are to set up and incorporate into my Halloween display. The flickering effect adds a fun, flame-like appearance that makes the yard feel a little more haunted, especially when combined with other Halloween decorations. Since they’re designed for outdoor use and are waterproof, they’re a convenient option for seasonal decorating without having to bring them inside every time the weather changes. The solar power is an added bonus because there’s no need to keep buying batteries or worry about running electrical cords across the yard. If you love Halloween as much as I do and want to add a spooky purple glow to your outdoor decorations, these solar torch lights are a fun and festive choice!
authors_reviews.author: Wisconsin

authors_reviews.title: Excellent

authors_reviews.title: Didn’t light up
authors_reviews.text: Lights looked amazing while still in the box. Lit up like they were supposed to but once I actually put them outside, they were already dead.They must have been shipped with the on light on so they were burnt out by the time they got to me. Very disappointed!!
authors_reviews.author: Kimberly

authors_reviews.title: Halloween decor
authors_reviews.text: Update: Four of the lights came back on after multiple days of recharging outside. I think the weather kept it from immediately working again. Thankfully I can use some of them instead of trashing the whole thing. Keeping my rating at four stars overall.Bought these last Halloween for a spooky ambiance and they worked great all season. Tried to re-use them this year but the lights wouldn't turn on. I guess these are made for only one season sadly. Wish the solar panel worked well enough to recharge after storage.
authors_reviews.author: Lina

authors_reviews.title: Don’t Stay On Long
authors_reviews.text: The purple color, the flicker, the cool design are all very nice but they do not stay lit for very long. I bought the 12 pk. They come on at dusk but most of them dim after a very short time (1-2 hours tops). They don’t seem to get charged enough during the day to give them long lasting power. Disappointed about that because they are very cool looking and I LOVE the purple color.
